svg.title: A coding agent is a model plus a harness
svg.desc: The harness sits between you, the model and everything else: it sends the model requests and gets back text or tool calls, then reads and edits files, runs commands and calls remote tools itself. There is no arrow between the model and your machine; the model never touches your files.

g.text: A coding agent is a model plus a harness
On your machine or a cloud VM
